map.预计完成日为什么有时比预期早很多？: Why is the expected completion date sometimes much earlier than expected?
map.单任务耗时怎么估计更准？: How can I estimate hours per task more accurately?
map.用「该科目近期真实完成若干任务的平均耗时」作 hours，比拍脑袋准；完成后再回: Use the average time of several recently completed tasks in that subject as hours — more accurate than guessing; after finishing, backfill the actual value and the tool gets closer to the real pace as data accumulates. Progress counts by task number regardless of difficulty; split heavy tasks for a smoother curve.
map.学习进度仪表是一款教育学习领域的在线工具。: Study Progress Dashboard is an online tool in the education and learning domain.
map.完成日按工作日推进：需学习天数 = ceil(剩余学时 ÷ 每日投入小时)，从今: Completion date advances by working days: days needed = ceil(remaining hours ÷ daily input hours); count that many working days from today (skipping weekends) to get the estimated completion date. Less remaining work or higher daily input finishes sooner. It assumes you can consistently put in the set hours every working day, so leave a buffer for time off.

map.多科目进度总览：按「科目,已完成,总数,单项工时」逐行登记；已完成/总数必须是非: Multi-subject overview: enter “subject, done, total, hours per task” line by line; done/total must be non-negative integers and hours must be positive. Invalid rows are listed with line numbers and reasons instead of being silently corrected. The tool totals overall progress and remaining hours.
map.输入写错了会怎样？: What happens if I mistype a row?
map.每行按 3–4 列严格校验：列数不足、科目为空、已完成不是非负整数、总数不是正整: Each row is checked for 3–4 columns: too few columns, empty subject, done not a non-negative integer, total not a positive integer, hours with units or ≤0, or done exceeding total are all listed with line number, raw text and reason; that row is excluded. A legitimate 0 (e.g. 0/10) is kept and never treated as “blank”.
